sentences.en: During the night, a wasp stung me in the temple.
sentences.zh: 夜里，一只黄蜂咬了我一下，咬在太阳穴上。

sentences.en: Yanni found bits of a dead wasp inside the fig.
sentences.zh: 雅尼发现无花果里有死掉的黄蜂碎片。

sentences.en: A wasp stung him and he had an allergic reaction.
sentences.zh: 他被黄蜂蜇了一下，出现了过敏反应。

senses.zh: 黄蜂；[昆] 胡蜂；易怒的人
